git_commits.message: Document STT reverse engineering audit, format evidence and reproducible experiments
Inspect partial local Frontier inputs and validate PSP ELF sections; exclude Switch
Decode limited MHXX LMT vector keys locally with bounded readers and synthetic tests
Verify Citra and PPSSPP trials and all 6657 MHFU DATA entries
Verify complete Frontier candidate headers against closed local census
Decode smallest Frontier JKR sample with bounded attributed LZ reader
Compare Frontier sample boundaries with public text layout hypotheses
Compare one deterministically selected Frontier JKR under 4 KiB
Validate one minimal MOD230 mesh span and record unresolved global index bounds
Delimit MOD230 index count conventions using pinned primary MH4U reader
Map one static PSP import-table reference against pinned PSPSDK layout
Document one LMT67 track reference review and unresolved independence gate
Validate one minimal 3DS TEX header and compressed data range without pixels
Corroborate static PSP section addresses with existing PPSSPP logs without new execution
Record complete local PC regression matrix: 106 tests and 21 tool interfaces
Document emulator compatibility and test new legible MH4U NCSD in Citra
Validate and decompress one MHXX update BLZ code set with segment bounds
Map one MHXX update startup reference using pinned loader and thread context
Probe one MH4U base NCSD executable partition without decompression
Decode one pinned MH4U code range with exact BLZ budget and segment backing
Document BLZ reference lineage review without claiming independent validation
Validate one catalogued MOD230 bone hierarchy and finite matrix tables
Record failed source-derived hierarchy matrix coherence property without bind-pose claims
